meta.note: Ananta, Arifin, Hasbullah, Handayani & Pramono (2014), A New Classification of Indonesia's Ethnic Groups (Based on the 2010 Population Census), ISEAS Working Paper. Parsed from Appendices 1-3. The paper states 633 groups (Appendix 3 total printed as 456), but the printed Appendix 3 table contains 453 rows (numbering skips #59 in the Sulawesi, Maluku and Papua blocks), so 630 groups are listed; nothing was padded. Locations: Kartapranata map labels (wm-map), Glottolog 5.4 (glottolog), own knowledge at regency level (manual), or province/island centroids with +/-0.15 deg deterministic jitter. precision tells how far to trust the point; "none" = not territorial. island is the island on which the point falls where located; "section" is the Appendix 3 heading as printed (several groups printed under "Others from Sulawesi" are Maluku/Aru groups).
